question:
Last summer, Julie went to London with her parents. They stayed in a small hotel near Hyde Park. On the first day, they visited the British Museum and saw some very old Egyptian objects. The next day, they took a boat on the Thames. Julie wanted to see a musical, but the tickets were too expensive, so they went to the cinema instead. Julie loved London, but she didn't like the food very much.

When did Julie go to London?

title: A trip to London

question:
Last summer, Julie went to London with her parents. They stayed in a small hotel near Hyde Park. On the first day, they visited the British Museum and saw some very old Egyptian objects.
